name: web-studio
description: A web design studio for Claude Code: a site in four locks or a page in two, from one round of questions to a locked design built as a working site in clean code. Runs standalone or as the design practice inside an agency-harness kernel project. Hebrew and RTL first. Carries an image toolkit on fal.ai with an enforced cap, GSAP and three.js craft, Hebrew type packs, a measured render check, a jury gate, and a WordPress adaptation for after the last lock.
